verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents card tables suited to bug tracking, plus MCP support, a CLI, and skills that let external AI agents access the product. These are developer building blocks for a user's own agent, not a documented Basecamp feature that automatically triages or prioritizes incoming bugs and tasks. No evidence shows native AI triage or prioritization.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks
